name: diamond
useFor: Use wherever a circle would mark a point: a map node, a step, a status, a list bullet. `variant="solid"` is confirmed or done, `variant="outline"` is pending or empty; give `fill` (the ground color) when lines behind should stop at the node. Pass Figma's size in px; it renders at the product scale. The color follows the text color.
constraints: Circles or dots for nodes and bullets
Colored nodes; they take the ink or Stone
source: Figma UI boards (442:2): the node on the map, steps, status and radio
title: Diamond
description: The survey node: a square turned 45 degrees, solid or outlined, that marks map points, steps, statuses, bullets and the radio.
